text: Setting up Zoho CRM? The order matters more than the features.
Start with company settings. Time zone, currency, fiscal year and hierarchy.
Then access. Roles, profiles and sharing, before you invite anyone.
Records are private by default. Sharing rules can only widen access.
Shape the pipeline to how you really sell. Then connect email.
Rules before data. Zoho says set up automation before you import.
Import 50 rows first. Once an import starts, it can't be cancelled.
Launch with a pilot group. Then review after two to four weeks.
Read the full step-by-step guide at zudoworks.com
